title: Annotated Gemini orbital photo #21: Midland, Odessa, Pecos R. and Stockton Plateau
description: Black-and-white orbital terrain photograph on a white mount card, marked "#21" with a north arrow at upper left. Handwritten labels identify "Midland", "Odessa", "Pecos R." and "Stockton Plateau". A dark diagonal band crosses the upper right of the frame, and vertical light streaks run along the left edge.
